Overview tab plotting six Workflows by Checks passed against latency, above a heatmap of Checks passed per Case Deploy Gates A deploy gate blocks a Workflow version from going live until it passes an Eval. To set one up, open the Workflow and click the dropdown next to "Publish". Under "Publishing Requirements", select "Require an Eval to pass". Choose an Eval, set the minimum pass rate for each Check (default 100%), and click "Save Checks". Click "Run Checks" to run the Eval on the latest saved version. When every Check passes, click "Publish". In "Auto-Publish" mode, each save runs the checks and the version publishes by itself when it passes. Each new version needs its own passing run. If you edit the Eval, versions that passed before must run the checks again. You need permission to manage Workflow deploy gates to set or remove a gate. HTTP API U

kflows. About An Eval combines a Dataset of Cases with a Spec that defines what to check. Each Case contains inputs and ground truth: the expected values or annotations. A Check selects an evaluator and its settings, such as how closely predicted boxes must match your annotations. A Run evaluates one or more Workflows against those Cases and Checks. Each Run captures its own inputs, ground truth, Workflow definitions, and evaluation settings. Editing or removing a Case affects future Runs; it does not change the results of existing Runs. Checks come in two kinds: an "Output check" compares a Workflow output with ground truth, and a "Latency budget" sets a time limit per Case.
